project.title: Z-Team Lingua — Preselection
project.description: Preselection execution board for the local-first Fulfulde accessibility layer: D1–D7 plan, gates, risks and submission.
project.readme:
# Z-Team Lingua — Preselection

Execution board for the SAFINUM Innovate Challenge 2026 preselection.

**Product:** a local-first Chrome MV3 extension that translates a financial web interface into Adamawa Fulfulde in place, speaks it, and never alters a protected financial value.

**Hard deadline:** 14 November 2026, 23:59 Africa/Douala.
**Internal submission:** 13 November 2026, 18:00.
**Freeze:** 12 November 2026, 18:00.

## How to read this board

- **Roadmap** — open work on the D1–D7 timeline.
- **Board** — status flow: Todo → In Progress → In Review → Blocked → Done.
- **Backlog** — every open item with area, phase, size and target date.
- **Blocked** — items that cannot move without a decision or external input.
- **Bugs** — defects only.
- **Submission** — the final D6 package.

## Non-negotiables

1. Protected values are byte-identical before and after translation.
2. Translation is in-page; audio is the accessibility layer on top.
3. No network egress except `127.0.0.1`.
4. No auto-submit and no bypassed confirmation.
5. Native-speaker validation is evidence, not a claim.

See `docs/PROJECT_BOARD.md` and `docs/decisions/` in the repository.

issues.title: plan: preselection execution (D1–D7)
issues.body:
## Goal

Umbrella issue for the SAFINUM Innovate Challenge 2026 preselection. This is the anchor for the D1–D7 board, gates and submission.

## Non-negotiables

- [ ] Protected values are byte-identical before and after translation.
- [ ] Translation is in-page; audio is the accessibility layer on top.
- [ ] No network egress except `127.0.0.1`.
- [ ] No auto-submit and no bypassed confirmation.
- [ ] Native-speaker validation is recorded as evidence.

## Gates

| Day | Gate |
| --- | --- |
| D1 | Balance page translated + spoken in <1.5 s; 0 value changes |
| D2 | Five pages, coverage ≥90%, 0 protected-node changes |
| D3 | P95 first audio <1 s; visual clean; TTS decision |
| D4 | Transfer end-to-end; no auto-submit; integrity tests |
| D5 | Freeze 18:00; ZIP ≤8 MB; mock B; novel content |
| D6 | 0 critical errors; PDF; video; submitted before 18:00 |
| D7 | Buffer only; hard deadline 14 Nov 23:59 |

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Five-step journey works on the live page in FR and EN.
- [ ] Coverage ≥90% of visible translatable nodes; 100% of high-risk labels and warnings.
- [ ] Every protected value is byte-identical (normalized comparison).
- [ ] P95 time-to-first-audio <1 s; first translation <150 ms after render.
- [ ] No blocking truncation at 1280×800 and 390×844.
- [ ] ZIP ≤8 MB; no secrets, models or large binaries in git.
- [ ] Video, technical note, repository and ZIP submitted before Friday 13 Nov 18:00.

## Links

- Board: https://github.com/users/Zeusse-Neumbi/projects/4
- Plan: `docs/PROJECT_BOARD.md` and `docs/decisions/`
- CI gate: `ci-required` on every pull request.

issues.title: feat(extension): thin end-to-end balance page
issues.body:
## Goal

Prove the thinnest end-to-end slice on the live balance page: scan, translate in place, speak the page, and leave every protected value untouched.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The scanner finds the balance-page text nodes and classifies protected values.
- [ ] The DOM translator replaces translatable nodes and reverts on any protected-value mismatch.
- [ ] `/tts` speaks the demo plan through a recorded clip or the stub, clearly marked.
- [ ] P95 time-to-first-audio <1.5 s on the demo machine.
- [ ] The amount, fee, total, reference, name and phone are byte-identical.

## Evidence

- `pnpm e2e`
- `pnpm test`
- A short screen recording or latency CSV in `eval/latency/`.

issues.title: feat(translator): v2 for mixed nodes, whitespace and idempotence
issues.body:
## Goal

Make the translator safe for the real page: mixed label/value nodes, whitespace, requestAnimationFrame and repeated passes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Mixed nodes are rewritten only through a validated pattern that preserves the value substring.
- [ ] NBSP, narrow NBSP, punctuation and line breaks are normalized without changing displayed values.
- [ ] A second translation pass is idempotent.
- [ ] A failed pass reverts the changed node and aborts the plan.

## Evidence

- `pnpm --filter @zteam/translator test`

- [ ] No model is shipped before a safety review.

issues.title: chore(deps): migrate TypeScript 7, Vitest 5 and @types/node 26

fields.Blocker: TypeScript 7 cannot resolve Node built-in types in packages/phrasebank; Vitest 5 requires Node >=22.12; WXT compatibility is unverified. The grouped PR #2 was closed.

issues.body:
## Blocker

Dependabot PR #2 grouped four major updates and failed CI:

- [Web job](https://github.com/Zeusse-Neumbi/z-team-lingua/actions/runs/42418439407/job/128541485965): `TS2591: Cannot find name 'node:fs'`, `node:url`, `process` in `packages/phrasebank`.
- [E2E job](https://github.com/Zeusse-Neumbi/z-team-lingua/actions/runs/42418439407/job/128541486012): the same build failure.
- Vitest 5 requires Node >=22.12 while `package.json` still advertises Node >=20.

## Why it cannot merge as-is

This is not a routine bump. TypeScript 7 changes type resolution, Vitest 5 raises the Node floor, and WXT 0.21.5 compatibility with both is unverified. The group must be split and each upgrade needs its own smoke test.

## Verification required before merging

- [ ] Add explicit `@types/node` to every package that uses Node built-ins, or document the root hoisting assumption.
- [ ] Raise `engines.node` and `.nvmrc` only if Vitest 5 is adopted.
- [ ] Run `pnpm install`, `pnpm ci:local`, `pnpm e2e` and `pnpm package`.
- [ ] Confirm WXT builds the extension with TypeScript 7.
- [ ] Re-run `pnpm audit --audit-level high`.

## Related

- Closed PR #2.
- Dependabot ignores the major versions until this issue is resolved.
